dogecoin.text: #BREAKING: #Roblox Content Creator Xeric Playz got his #YouTube account hacked! His username was changed to Dogecoin. The hackers are streaming #dogecoin and #Bitcoin scams. We advise you to avoid the stream. Click at your own risk!

UPDATE (#BREAKING): #Roblox Content Creator XericPlayz has gotten his #YouTube channel back! He was hacked by #Dogecoin/#Bitcoin scammers yesterday and the community was in full support for the #YouTuber. The community now cheers as his channel was reverted back.
